faq.q: Is The Marina confirmed to be in GTA 6?
faq.a: The Marina is treated by outlets as a confirmed but still loosely bounded district, visible in Trailer 2, though it lacks a dedicated Rockstar Newswire naming.

faq.q: What makes The Marina different from Vice City's beach districts?
faq.a: It is described as a quieter, wealthier waterfront section with boats, jet skis and luxury properties, contrasting with the neon nightlife of the beach districts.

faq.q: Where exactly is The Marina located in Vice City?
faq.a: Not known. No official map, exact borders or full name have been published by Rockstar for this area.

faq.q: What confidence level does this entry have?
faq.a: Confidence is medium, reflecting press-only sourcing rather than a first-party Rockstar confirmation.

notKnown: Whether Rockstar will publish a dedicated naming for it.
howWeKnow: PCGamesN's map coverage of GTA 6 described The Marina from footage in Trailer 2, released 6 May 2026, as a quieter waterfront district. Rockstar has not published a dedicated naming for it, so this entry is press-reported with medium confidence.
